resources.title: Open Source Guides
resources.why: A primary reading map for the non-code parts of open source.
resources.apply: Choose a relevant chapter and turn its advice into a checklist, template or decision.
resources.caveat: The whole guide corpus has not been read; the initial chapter coverage is listed separately.
resources.coverage: Index inspected; linked chapter coverage is bounded.

resources.title: Starting an Open Source Project
resources.why: Connect project purpose with README, contribution and launch expectations.
resources.apply: Use the first-use questions to review the front page and contribution path.
resources.caveat: Project-specific legal decisions still need appropriate review.
resources.coverage: Launch, README, contribution and branding sections inspected.

resources.title: Best Practices for Maintainers
resources.why: Makes scope and contribution expectations explicit.
resources.apply: Document review expectations and reasons for declining out-of-scope work.
resources.caveat: A written process is not proof that the project follows it.
resources.coverage: Documentation, expectations and response sections inspected.

resources.title: Building Welcoming Communities
resources.why: Frames onboarding as a progression from user to contributor.
resources.apply: Make one contribution path small, understandable and verifiable.
resources.caveat: Do not promise review capacity or response times that have not been established.

resources.title: Accessibility Best Practices
resources.why: Identifies barriers in docs, media and contribution workflows.
resources.apply: Review headings, link text, image alternatives and non-color status information.
resources.caveat: Automated or source-only checks cannot certify accessibility.
resources.coverage: Documentation, interface and testing guidance inspected; no assistive-technology test performed.

resources.title: GitHub community profile
resources.why: Explains GitHub recognition of community files and templates.
resources.apply: Use supported file locations and inspect the actual resulting community profile.
resources.caveat: File detection does not establish content quality, security or legal compliance.
resources.coverage: Community-profile documentation inspected; BeautifulRepo profile not verified.

resources.title: Hacktoberfest 2026
resources.why: Provides current event rules rather than inherited contribution folklore.
resources.apply: Check event fit; use current activities rather than obsolete PR-reward instructions.
resources.caveat: 2026 PRs and MRs do not count toward rewards; listing does not imply enrollment.

resources.title: Google Summer of Code timeline
resources.why: Provides year-specific application and project milestones.
resources.apply: Read the detailed year section before advising an application or mentoring plan.
resources.caveat: 2026 application deadlines are past; 2027 dates and project eligibility are not asserted.
resources.coverage: Detailed 2026 timeline inspected; generic summary is not used for dates.

resources.title: Devostasis
resources.why: Demonstrates inspectable repository-state reports with explicit uncertainty.
resources.apply: Borrow truthful evidence presentation; evaluate runtime integration separately.
resources.caveat: README inspection is not installation or a test of runtime claims.
resources.coverage: README blob d20eb2ba4b9ada56d5c7d9d67a1cc8048668eb96 inspected in full.

resources.title: Hungry Crab
resources.why: Connects repository research to concrete transfer decisions.
resources.apply: Record why a pattern is useful, how to apply it and why reuse may be limited.
resources.caveat: No automated ingestion, license determination or issue-serving behavior tested.
resources.coverage: README introduction, walkthrough, configuration and miners inspected; remaining sections unread.

resources.title: Gum
resources.why: Connects a visible demo to an example script and a short tutorial.
resources.apply: Use result-to-source navigation and collapse secondary installation paths.
resources.caveat: Source inspection is not a visual audit or permission to copy media.
